rows: National parliamentary intention and vote-plus-sympathy trend
Random telephone sample: 403 Andorran citizens plus 399 non-citizens (802 total). Voting estimates use the citizen sample; decided-party subset n=195, vote-plus-sympathy subset n=275.

Decided vote: Concòrdia 37.9%, DA alliance 29.2%, Andorra Endavant 22.1%, PS 10.3%, Liberals 0.5%. Vote plus sympathy (different denominator): 35.5%, 27.1%, 19.1%, 11.7%, SDP 2.2%, Liberals 1.5%; other/unclassified detail retained in the source.

Same published vote-plus-sympathy series, spring 2025 → spring 2026: DA alliance 33.4 → 27.1 (−6.3 pp); Concòrdia 30.2 → 35.5 (+5.3); Andorra Endavant 16.1 → 19.1 (+3.0). Statistical significance of these changes is not established.
Early governing-list exposure in Canillo, Encamp, Ordino and La Massana; local coalition re-formation and parish polls required

Of all 403 citizens, 35.2% were undecided and 9.6% declined to answer. Reported ±4.95 pp error applies to the citizen sample, not smaller decided-vote subsets or individual parishes. AR+I publishes national-list estimates only because parish samples are inadequate. Fieldwork ended 116 days before the snapshot; local elections are more than a year away. National alliance labels and municipal coalitions differ.
